chains.title: Permit plus hiring acceleration
chains.cre_mechanism: Capacity demand precedes same-site expansion or additional premises.
chains.observable_precursor: New/alteration permit coincides with sustained occupation-specific hiring.
chains.time_valid_feature: permit_age_days, hiring_count_90d and source-family agreement measured at decision time
chains.falsification_test: Compare future verified space requirements for permit-only, hiring-only and combined cohorts.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether growth is constrained by floor area, loading, power or staffing and whether an additional site is being evaluated.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Import-volume capability expansion
chains.cre_mechanism: Growing import/distribution activity can require storage, yard or cross-dock capacity.
chains.observable_precursor: New or broadened importer product footprint plus local establishment evidence.
alternative_explanations: customs broker listed instead of importer
chains.falsification_test: Adjudicate whether named firms actually operate local warehousing and compare future requirements.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Verify receiving, inventory and distribution constraints and expansion timing.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed warehouse, yard or distribution requirement.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Public contract capacity step-up
chains.cre_mechanism: A material new contract can require labour, equipment and production/storage capacity.
chains.observable_precursor: First or unusually large public award joined to a physical operating site.
chains.falsification_test: Compare requirement rates by award type, size and physical-delivery intensity.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask where the contract will be fulfilled and whether current premises can support it.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed contract-driven space or relocation need.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Grant-funded scale-up
chains.cre_mechanism: Capital or commercialization funding can finance facility expansion.
chains.observable_precursor: New contribution describing scale-up, equipment, manufacturing or facility investment.
alternative_explanations: research grant with no facility impact
chains.falsification_test: Blind-code grant descriptions and test prospective requirements by category.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask what physical capacity the funded program requires and its site decision deadline.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed funded expansion, fit-out or acquisition requirement.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Regulatory permission for new capacity
chains.cre_mechanism: Regulated operations often need approvals before constructing or expanding capacity.
chains.observable_precursor: New or amended environmental or facility permission at an operating address.
chains.falsification_test: Separate capacity-changing permissions from administrative amendments and compare outcomes.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether the permission supports new equipment, throughput or a new site.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Regulated licence class expansion
chains.cre_mechanism: New regulated product or device classes can require compliant production, storage or quality space.
chains.observable_precursor: Licence issue/amendment adds activity or class at a company/location.
chains.falsification_test: Test whether activity changes precede verified facility changes after excluding address-only administration.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether new licensed activities will be performed in-house and what space standard is required.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed compliant facility, storage or production need.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Food export approval expansion
chains.cre_mechanism: New export eligibility or product scope can require certified production and cold-chain capacity.
chains.observable_precursor: Establishment/operator appears in or expands within food export registries.
chains.falsification_test: Compare new entries with stable incumbents and verify physical production location.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether export growth requires processing, freezer, dock or inspection capacity.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Cluster spillover from major project
chains.cre_mechanism: Large capital projects can shift supplier demand and local space needs.
chains.observable_precursor: Nearby capital project enters funded/active stage while relevant suppliers win work or hire.
chains.falsification_test: Use matched unaffected corridors and sector-specific supplier cohorts.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether project demand changes inventory, crew, yard or service-location requirements.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Old/new address overlap
chains.cre_mechanism: A business preparing to move often creates a temporary overlap across permits, licences or directories.
chains.observable_precursor: Same entity appears at a new address while old location remains active.
chains.falsification_test: Adjudicate actual moves and compare overlap patterns with new branches.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Clarify whether the new address is relocation, expansion or administration and identify remaining site decisions.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed move, branch or renewal decision.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Fit-out at alternate site
chains.cre_mechanism: Tenant improvements at a different address may precede relocation or branch opening.
chains.observable_precursor: Interior alteration/occupancy permit linked to a known operating entity at another address.
chains.falsification_test: Manually verify tenant identity and compare with same-address permits.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether the alternate site replaces or supplements the current operation and whether brokerage help remains timely.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed relocation, branch or already-committed exclusion.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Licence transfer or address amendment
chains.cre_mechanism: Regulated businesses must update location-specific licences around a move.
chains.observable_precursor: Licence address changes or a new location-specific licence appears.
chains.falsification_test: Verify operating-site meaning by licence class and field evidence.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether the location change is complete, planned or one stage of a larger facility decision.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed relocation timing or post-commitment exclusion.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Redevelopment displacement
chains.cre_mechanism: Redevelopment, demolition or conversion can force occupier relocation.
chains.observable_precursor: Planning or permit activity affects a parcel with active business occupiers.
chains.falsification_test: Track project progression and compare occupier moves with matched parcels.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask about notice, renewal, continuity and replacement-site requirements.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Access disruption relocation pressure
chains.cre_mechanism: Persistent road, construction or infrastructure disruption can reduce operational suitability.
chains.observable_precursor: Long-duration access disruption overlaps a location with access-sensitive operations.
chains.falsification_test: Compare retention/move outcomes for affected and nearby unaffected establishments.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether access, deliveries or customer traffic is creating a site decision.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed access-driven relocation, redesign or no-need.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Market-submarket renewal pressure
chains.cre_mechanism: Lease expiries and changing availability/rents alter renewal-versus-relocation economics.
chains.observable_precursor: Submarket lease-expiry wave or availability shift combined with occupier age/location constraints.
chains.falsification_test: Use consistent definitions and test only as contextual modifier, not direct lead.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Frame renewal-versus-relocation options and ask about decision timing.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: New corporation plus physical licence
chains.cre_mechanism: A newly formed operation obtaining a local licence may need premises.
chains.observable_precursor: New active corporation joins to first local operating licence or directory entry.
chains.falsification_test: Compare corporate formation alone with formation-plus-physical licence.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether premises are secured, temporary or still being evaluated.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed first premises, branch or already-secured exclusion.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: New regulated operator
chains.cre_mechanism: Initial regulated licence issuance often corresponds to a new operating capability.
chains.observable_precursor: First facility/operator licence appears with local address.
chains.falsification_test: Stratify by licence activity and physical-space intensity.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask what functions occur at the address and future compliant-space requirements.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed initial or next-stage facility need.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: First importer footprint
chains.cre_mechanism: New importing activity can mark market entry requiring distribution capacity.
chains.observable_precursor: Firm first appears as importer for a product family in a GTA city.
chains.falsification_test: Verify entity role and repeat presence before promotion.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask how products are received, stored and distributed and whether local capacity is fixed.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: New food or health establishment
chains.cre_mechanism: New inspected/licensed operation requires compliant premises.
chains.observable_precursor: New food inspection or regulated establishment record appears at a commercial address.
chains.falsification_test: Distinguish first operation from rebranding and compare subsequent expansion.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether the current site is launch-stage or intended long-term capacity.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed launch, expansion or compliance-space need.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Licence suspension or cancellation
chains.cre_mechanism: Loss of authorization can create consolidation, sublease or disposition needs.
chains.observable_precursor: Regulatory licence is suspended, cancelled or reduced.
chains.falsification_test: Use as competing-risk and specialized advisory signal; compare recovery outcomes.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Determine whether operations are pausing, relocating, selling assets or releasing space.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Insolvency plus multi-site footprint
chains.cre_mechanism: Formal insolvency can force rapid occupancy rationalization.
chains.observable_precursor: Insolvency record joins to multiple active establishments or owned properties.
chains.falsification_test: Require high-confidence entity resolution and test economic/serviceability outcomes.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Route only to specialized senior handling; ask about occupancy strategy if authorized.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Employment contraction with site persistence
chains.cre_mechanism: Sustained employment decline may precede consolidation or surplus space.
chains.observable_precursor: Multi-period establishment employment range falls while site remains active.
chains.falsification_test: Use repeated vintages and compare with sector trends.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether staffing changes have altered space utilization or consolidation plans.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Portfolio duplicate-site overlap
chains.cre_mechanism: Mergers or acquisitions can create redundant nearby facilities.
chains.observable_precursor: Common parent controls multiple nearby same-function establishments.
chains.falsification_test: Adjudicate known mergers and compare consolidation rates.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether the combined network is being rationalized and where capacity gaps remain.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed consolidation, disposition or expansion counter-event.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Parcel redevelopment with tenant roster
chains.cre_mechanism: Advancing redevelopment creates a finite relocation clock for tenants.
chains.observable_precursor: Application stage progresses on a parcel with current occupier evidence.
chains.falsification_test: Track stage progression and occupier exits prospectively.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask about notice, continuity requirements and replacement-site specifications.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Demolition permit precursor
chains.cre_mechanism: Demolition approval can shorten the remaining occupancy horizon.
chains.observable_precursor: Demolition or major redevelopment permit is applied for or issued.
chains.falsification_test: Compare occupier status at application versus issue and exclude already-vacant sites.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Confirm occupancy and relocation responsibility.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed urgent relocation or non-occupancy exclusion.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Zoning/use incompatibility transition
chains.cre_mechanism: A proposed use change can displace existing industrial or service operations.
chains.observable_precursor: A planning or development application proposes a use materially incompatible with the current active industrial or service occupier.
chains.falsification_test: Require application evidence and active occupier match.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether future use affects renewal or continuity.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Capital project land pressure
chains.cre_mechanism: Transit, road or public works projects can acquire or impair commercial sites.
chains.observable_precursor: Funded project footprint overlaps or materially affects a business property.
chains.falsification_test: Track confirmed footprint and affected-property notices.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask about acquisition, access, parking and continuity implications.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed relocation, acquisition or mitigation need.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Environmental permission bottleneck
chains.cre_mechanism: A facility unable to obtain or amend permission may need another site or costly retrofit.
chains.observable_precursor: Permission application, amendment or compliance event conflicts with current use/capacity.
chains.falsification_test: Compare delayed/denied versus routine permissions and field-confirm site impact.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether site constraints are limiting equipment, throughput or future plans.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed retrofit, relocation or no-space issue.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Loading and yard mismatch
chains.cre_mechanism: Distribution growth can exceed loading, truck court or outdoor-storage capacity.
chains.observable_precursor: Importer/contract/hiring growth occurs at a property with constrained parcel/building characteristics.
chains.falsification_test: Field-audit property constraints and compare with confirmed requirements.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask about dock, trailer, yard and circulation constraints.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Power/process intensity mismatch
chains.cre_mechanism: Manufacturing or specialized operations may outgrow power, ventilation, drainage or servicing.
chains.observable_precursor: New equipment/process permission or regulated activity appears at an older/incompatible facility.
chains.falsification_test: Validate with field questions and permits; reject without facility-fit evidence.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask about power, HVAC, drainage, clean-room or process utility constraints.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed specialized facility upgrade or move.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Parking/customer access constraint
chains.cre_mechanism: Employment or customer growth can exceed parking and access capacity.
chains.observable_precursor: Employment/hiring growth at a constrained site with recurring access evidence.
chains.falsification_test: Compare affected sites and field-confirm operational impact.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether parking, customer access or shift change is limiting growth.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Corporate control change with owned property
chains.cre_mechanism: Acquisition or control change can trigger sale-leaseback, consolidation or expansion.
chains.observable_precursor: Federal corporate control/name changes join to owned commercial property.
chains.falsification_test: Adjudicate ownership and compare post-change property events.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Escalate to senior realtor to discuss portfolio strategy where relationship rules permit.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed acquisition, disposition or consolidation opportunity.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Founder/owner succession proxy
chains.cre_mechanism: Long-established private owner-occupiers may reconsider property strategy during succession.
chains.observable_precursor: Long tenure, owner-occupied property and corporate/director transition evidence.
chains.falsification_test: Treat only as exploratory; require direct field confirmation and no sensitive inference.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask neutral business-planning questions, not personal succession assumptions.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Portfolio sale or listing emergence
chains.cre_mechanism: Owner decisions become observable through new listing or transfer activity.
chains.observable_precursor: Property listing/transfer appears for an occupied business site.
chains.falsification_test: Track listings and transfers with occupier outcomes.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask occupier about continuity and owner/user options only when appropriate.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Insolvency as competing risk
chains.cre_mechanism: Financial distress may reduce ability to transact even when space pressure exists.
chains.observable_precursor: Insolvency or restructuring evidence joins to an otherwise high-scoring candidate.
chains.falsification_test: Measure booking and economic outcomes separately; default to penalty or specialist queue.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Do not use generic field route unless serviceability and authority pass.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Public funding dependence
chains.cre_mechanism: A project may be viable only after funding closes, changing timing and confidence.
chains.observable_precursor: Grant or contract is announced but not yet effective/paid.
chains.falsification_test: Separate announced, signed, effective and paid clocks.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether funding conditions are complete before treating space need as actionable.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Market rent pressure on marginal use
chains.cre_mechanism: Rising or falling rent can change consolidation or relocation economics.
chains.observable_precursor: Submarket cost change intersects with low-utilization or constrained establishment.
chains.falsification_test: Use only as contextual economic modifier and test incremental value.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Frame options after a direct need is confirmed.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Supplier co-location pressure
chains.cre_mechanism: Large customer or anchor movement can change optimal supplier location.
chains.observable_precursor: Verified contract or supplier relationship plus anchor project/site movement.
chains.falsification_test: Require explicit relationship evidence and compare dependent/nondependent suppliers.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether customer-location changes affect inventory or service radius.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Importer and exporter network broadening
chains.cre_mechanism: More origins/products/export markets can increase inventory and handling complexity.
chains.observable_precursor: Importer product breadth or export-registry scope expands over time.
chains.falsification_test: Use repeated snapshots and verify operator role.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask how network growth changes storage, cold chain and shipping needs.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Labour geography mismatch
chains.cre_mechanism: Hiring difficulty can motivate relocation toward labour pools or transit.
chains.observable_precursor: Persistent specialized vacancies coincide with location/access constraints.
chains.falsification_test: Compare local/site-specific hiring and field-confirm geographic constraint.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask whether labour access is affecting location strategy.
chains.measurable_field_result: confirmed labour-driven move or no-space issue.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Medical-device activity upgrade
chains.cre_mechanism: Higher device classes or manufacturing activities can require controlled facilities.
chains.observable_precursor: MDEL activity/class changes and hiring/permit corroboration.
chains.falsification_test: Stratify import/distribute/manufacture and require physical corroboration.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask about clean, storage, quality and production-space requirements.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Natural-health product site scaling
chains.cre_mechanism: Manufacturing, packaging, labelling or importing licences imply different facility needs.
chains.observable_precursor: Site licence issue/amendment plus local establishment growth.
chains.falsification_test: Verify in-house activity and facility location.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask which licensed functions occur on-site and what capacity is constrained.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.

chains.title: Food and cold-chain compliance expansion
chains.cre_mechanism: New products/markets and inspection requirements can force specialized processing or storage.
chains.observable_precursor: Food registry/export change plus permit, grant or hiring evidence.
chains.falsification_test: Require operator-location identity and compare scope changes with no-change controls.
chains.tip_sheet_action: Ask about processing, refrigeration, sanitation, dock and inspection capacity.
chains.rejection_trigger: No prospective timing or no incremental field value.
